subject: Re: MAP - Technical Evaluation Plan and Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-07-12T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Acme MAP kickoff / next steps

Hi team,

Quick recap from the discovery with Samantha/Tom at Acme earlier today:
- Use case: in-product search & RAG for merchandising + return-to-shelf assistant.
- Primary PO: Samantha (Sr. Product Manager).
- Success measures they care about: precision@5 for search rerank, latency p95 < 250ms for 1-2k QPS bursts, and monthly inference cost <$0.0015/token (target).
- Constraints: must run in their preferred cloud region (us-west-2) and pass basic SOC2+security questionnaire.

Requested next steps we committed to:
1) Send a MAP draft with milestones, owners, target close date (they're aiming for early Sept).
2) Share technical evaluation criteria + model shortlist and suggested benchmarking plan.
3) Provide an initial cost/latency projection and note dependencies (SRE access, test dataset, security questionnaire).

I'm drafting the MAP now — can you both review and add sprint-level milestones where appropriate? Rishi, please add initial perf target proposals; Soojin, can you confirm what SRE access we need for the eval?

I'll consolidate and send to Acme by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa

Sounds good — high level notes from me:
- Latency: aim for p95 < 200ms on standard 8k context model in our hosted infra, but call out that 250ms is acceptable for initial PoC if they need higher quality models.
- Cost: target inference cost <$0.0015/token, but we'll provide 3 profiles (high perf, balanced, low cost) with model/quantization options.
- Models to shortlist: Llama 3 34B (quant), Mistral Large, and a tuned Llama 2 variant if customer prefers.

Soojin — for SRE access, we'll need a temporary VPN jump host or S3 test bucket + IAM role and a service account to hit their test endpoints if they want on-prem evaluation.

I can draft the perf targets and a simple benchmarking matrix by tomorrow morning.

- Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: MAP v1 + Technical Evaluation Plan (ACME)

Hi Samantha / Tom — great chat yesterday, thanks for the time.

Please find attached: 1) Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft) and 2) technical_eval_criteria.pdf (evaluation plan). High-level summary below, and a few asks so we can kick off the benchmark next week.

MAP (milestones & owners):
- Milestone 1 — Requirements alignment: Marissa (Owner), 2026-07-16. Deliverable: final MAP + test dataset schema.
- Milestone 2 — SRE access & security review: Acme SRE (Owner), 2026-07-20. Deliverable: access to staging endpoints / completed security questionnaire.
- Milestone 3 — Baseline benchmark (PoC): Rishi (Owner), 2026-07-28. Deliverable: benchmark report comparing model shortlist on latency, cost, and quality metrics.
- Milestone 4 — Integration pilot: Soojin (Owner), 2026-08-11. Deliverable: integrated endpoint + sample traffic.
- Milestone 5 — Business review & close: Marissa (Owner), target close 2026-09-01.

Dependencies:
- Access: staging endpoints or S3 test data (Acme action).
- Security: completed questionnaire + network config for bench runs.
- Exec buy-in: internal Acme legal & procurement timeline for contract.

Technical Evaluation Plan (benchmark success criteria):
- Quality: precision@5 >= 0.62 on their labeled search test set OR F1 >= 0.58 on return-to-shelf classification tasks.
- Latency: p95 inference latency <= 250ms for standard query payload at representative request sizes; target p50 <= 90ms.
- Throughput: sustain short bursts to 2k QPS with graceful degradation and documented fallback policies.
- Cost: median inference cost <= $0.0015/token for balanced profile; include high-perf and low-cost profiles in report.
- Stability: no more than 2% error rate (timeouts/5xx) during benchmark runs.

Model shortlist (initial):
- Candidate A: Llama 3 34B quantized (balanced)
- Candidate B: Mistral Large (throughput-optimized)
- Candidate C: Llama 2 fine-tuned variant (quality-focused)
- Fallback: smaller quantized 13B option for strict cost envelope

Benchmark methodology:
- Use a shared test set (Acme provides) and a synthetic load generator simulating peak traffic.
- Run three repeats of each model/config, capture latency percentiles, token counts, and token-level cost.
- Include end-to-end integration test to measure any additional app-level latency.

Asks for Acme to start the eval:
1) Share a sample test dataset (anonymized) by 2026-07-16.
2) Confirm who on your SRE team can provide staging access / network details (cc your SRE or share a temporary IAM/service account).
3) Accept the MAP draft in the attached spreadsheet or provide edits by 2026-07-18 so we can keep the PoC schedule.

Attachments: acme_map_v1.xlsx, technical_eval_criteria.pdf

I'll schedule a short 30-min kickoff once we have the test data and SRE contact. Let me know if you want the bench to prioritize cost vs quality for the first run.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

We'll review the MAP spreadsheet and propose edits by EOD Monday. Looking forward to the kickoff.
